t: You're at the Criterion Theatre and Restaurant, a building in Westminster. It was designed by Thomas Verity, who lived from 1837 to 1891 and was an English theatre architect. He worked during the great theatre-building boom that ran from 1885 to 1915, when new playhouses were going up across the country. The Criterion is one of his designs, so you're standing in front of a piece of that Victorian and Edwardian theatre-building energy.
